notes.title: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215084/147162e880526ef21b75b0fa065d77d92dabc286.png
O cursed walkers! Weep and despair!
Morbidware studio is announcing its new game in collaboration with Stockholm Kartell: MÖRK BORG Heresy Supreme! We regret to bring ruin to the gaming world with this heavy metal Action RPG set in the grimdark fantasy lands of the award winning tabletop rpg MÖRK BORG.


Explore the lands of the dying world with a party of wretched antiheroes
Find a way to delay the inevitable doomsday by completing quests
Make your cursed walkers improve their skills and face challenging battles and twisted encounters with the dwellers of the dying world
Follow the path of the two-headed Basilisks… or commit the Heresy Supreme!


Follow us on Kickstarter to be the first to know when the campaign launches
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1358662172/mork-borg-heresy-supreme

Watch the announcement trailer now!
https://youtu.be/GwXgQ1buEZ4
